column3: Close to the Hebrew; “a youth” is rendered “a child.”
Close to the Hebrew; “he took them on his arms” is rendered “Taking them by their arms.”

Close to the Hebrew; “cords of humankind” is rendered “gentle cords,” “those who lift the yoke on their jaws” “those who take the yoke from their neck,” and “I bend down to him [and] feed” “I stooped and fed them.”
NKJV renders “the sword will whirl” as “shall slash,” and “his bars” as “his districts”; the meaning of the word is uncertain.

NKJV renders “my people are hung up on turning from me; to the height they call him, together he will not exalt” as “bent on backsliding from Me. Though they call to the Most High, None at all exalt Him”; the meaning is uncertain.
Close to the Hebrew; “my compassions have grown warm together” is rendered “My sympathy is stirred,” and “my heart has turned over within me” “My heart churns within Me.”
Close to the Hebrew; “in rage” is rendered “with terror.”
Close to the Hebrew; “children” is rendered “His sons.”

MT 12:1. NKJV renders “Judah still roams with God, and with the holy ones [is] faithful” as “But Judah still walks with God, Even with the Holy One who is faithful”; the meaning of the Hebrew is uncertain.
